description: Load any shared Bisque presentation for reading: its metadata, the full per-slide narration transcript with timestamps, and the context.md file its author shipped for agents (extra background the slides summarize). Target it by watch URL (https://bisque.today/p/{handle}/{slug}) or by handle + slug — it does not have to be yours. Use this to read, summarize, cite, or answer questions about a presentation: ground your answers in the returned transcript and context, and cite slides as [slide N].

slug.description: URL slug, the last path segment of the watch URL. Use with handle, or pass url instead.

url.description: Watch URL, e.g. https://bisque.today/p/{handle}/{slug}. Provide this OR handle + slug.

name: get_presentation_context

contextMd.description: The bundle's context.md (shared agent-facing background); null when the presentation ships none.

transcript.description: Per-slide narration, ordered by slide index.

transcriptTruncatedSlides.description: Content slides the size-capped transcript dropped; 0 = complete.

title: Load a presentation into context
